effects.title: Hello
effects.summary: The smallest effect: three layers of soft violet orbs drifting in the dark under one haloed light, in one fragment pass through the HDR tail. Every later effect starts from this shape.

useCases: The template for new effects; a dark ambient hero at a pinch

effects.title: Lens model
effects.summary: A night street through a camera lens: two rows of lamps and a railing of small lights receding from half a metre to six hundred, each drawn as the aperture at its own circle of confusion, while the focus walks through them. Every point keeps its light as it blurs; switch that off to see why it matters.

scorecard.fallback: A still of the street in focus at mid-distance.
useCases: Seeing the lens model and the aperture shapes; a building block, not an effect to ship

effects.title: Bokeh drift
effects.summary: Points of light far behind a lens focused close: a field of soft violet discs at many depths, drifting upwards under one bright light in haze. Each disc is the aperture at its own circle of confusion and keeps the light of the point it came from, so overlaps add up as they do in a photograph. The pointer shifts them by depth.

scorecard.fallback: A still of the orbs; a CSS version with radial gradients comes close (plan story 7.4).
useCases: A dark hero or section background that moves without asking for attention
Night, music, nightlife and event sites
